You trust one source of truth, and it's the ATS.
A skills score that sits in a separate tab is a score half your team never sees. TestGorilla integrations close that gap — every assessment, score, and candidate insight syncs to their record in your ATS automatically.
Our plug-and-play integrations
Our Plug & Play integrations are easy to set up, letting you connect TestGorilla directly to your existing tools for a seamless workflow. Looking for more flexibility? We also offer convenient connectors like Zapier.
Build your own integration
Have dedicated IT resources and need an integration that isn’t on the list? Larger teams with their own IT resources can build a custom integration with any ATS through our open API. Automate the steps you repeat, connect more than one tool, and shape the workflow around how your team actually hires.

TestGorilla integrates with leading applicant tracking systems, including Greenhouse, Workable, Lever, Teamtailor, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, BambooHR, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, and more. You can also connect to hundreds of other tools through Zapier or Make, or build a custom integration with any system using our open API. The full current list is on this page.
Once connected, you send TestGorilla assessments from inside your ATS, track who’s completed them, and review results on the candidate’s record. Scores and insights sync back automatically, so your hiring team sees them without switching between tools or retyping candidate data.
Most TestGorilla integrations are self-serve. You connect them in your account settings and follow the steps for your specific ATS. Some integrations need an API key or admin permission inside your ATS. If you’d rather have help, our team can walk you through it.
Yes. When a candidate finishes an assessment, their results sync to their record in your ATS automatically, so hiring managers see the score next to everything else in their pipeline.
ATS integrations are available on our Plus plan. If you’re on the Free or Core plan and want an integration, talk to our team about your options. Current plans and pricing are on the pricing page.
You’ve got two options. Connect through Zapier or Make, which link TestGorilla to hundreds of tools without code, or build a direct integration with our open API if you have IT resources. If a specific system is blocking you, talk to our team. We’ll tell you what’s possible today and what’s planned.
Yes. Plus customers can build bespoke integrations using our open API, which lets you create custom workflows and connect TestGorilla to any ATS or system. You can find the API documentation in your account settings.
Yes. TestGorilla connects with both Zapier and Make, so you can link it to hundreds of other applications and automate steps between TestGorilla and the rest of your tech stack—without heavy coding. See the Zapier integration guide and the Make integration guide in our help center.
